preconditions.description: The root must be a valid TreeNode object.
The number of nodes in the BST must be between 1 and 10,000.
The input must be a valid binary search tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == sum_greater_nodes(node, root) for node in inorder_traversal(root))
postconditions.description: Each node's value must be updated to the sum of all nodes greater than itself.
The transformed tree must still be a valid binary search tree.
